newsitem.title: USA: Quaker looking for next Mike in cereal contest.
newsitem.headline: Quaker looking for next Mike in cereal contest.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co. is looking for someone to be like Mike, but not the Mike of basketball fame.

In an attempt to revive sagging sales of its Life cereal brand, Quaker plans to resurrect the memorable commercial featuring Mikey, the finicky lad who wordlessly downed the breakfast cereal to the amazement of his conniving older brothers. The commercials, recalled by the baby-boomer generation, were developed about 20 years ago.
The contest -- Be the next Mikey -- is open to boys and girls aged three to 12 and ends June 30. Entry forms and instructions will be available on boxes of Life and Cinnamon Life cereal.
The winner of the contest will appear on cereal boxes and in a new advertising campaign and collect $10,000. Quaker also will award 130 prizes to runners up ranging from $100 to $5,000.
